subject: Discovery recap — pick 30m walkthrough + ops checklist
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@aureliasys.com>, Claire Li <claire.li@aureliasys.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — pick 30m walkthrough + ops checklist

Hi Alex / Claire,

Thanks again for the time today — useful conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re aligned before a short product walkthrough: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce inference unit cost while keeping 95th/99th p99 latency within current SLAs for user-facing features.
- Key stakeholders to include: Platform/infra lead (for routing/caching questions), Engineering manager (owner of PQ/latency), and procurement for contract/term questions.
- Expected scale: pilot ~200k tokens/day, target production ~3–5M tokens/day across multiple models.

Success criteria for the walkthrough
- Show how Redwood would handle prefix/KV caching and batching for your request patterns
- Surface expected per-token cost with a recommended config and fallback model strategy
- Confirm security posture for VPC/private deployments (we’ll bring docs to the security follow-up)

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (one-page timeline), product-one-pager.pdf — quick refs.

Next step: 30-minute product walkthrough (we’ll demo UI + a short infra-focused deep dive and leave time for Q&A). Could you confirm who from Aurelia should attend (I noted Platform/Infra + Engineering manager + procurement optional)? If that’s right, I’ll propose 2–3 concrete 30-minute windows in PST.

If you already have preferred days/times, say so and I’ll prioritize them. Otherwise I’ll send options tomorrow.

Thanks — happy to coordinate.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Great — thanks Alex. Based on your mid-week AM preference, propose three 30-minute windows (all PST):

Option A: Wed 2027-10-13 09:00–09:30 PST
Option B: Wed 2027-10-13 10:30–11:00 PST
Option C: Thu 2027-10-14 09:30–10:00 PST

Agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: quick context & goals (Hannah)
- 5–18m: product walkthrough focused on inference routing, caching, and cost (Karthik will demo)
- 18–26m: scale/latency discussion & architecture fit (Karthik + Mateo)
- 26–30m: next steps / actions (capture owners)

Please pick the option that works and confirm attendees (we’ll add an invite with calendar links). I’ve also attached a short demo-prep checklist (demo-prep-checklist.docx) with recommended data and goals so the session is actionable.

Internal note to Karthik / Mateo:
> Heads up — please be prepared to show 95th/99th tail latency numbers for a ~500 concurrent request pattern and a short slide on prefix/KV caching behavior. Also bring a short cost example for a 2M-token/day workload.

If any of these slots are tight, I can open up Fri morning as backup.

Thanks,
Hannah
